evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: Nanni Loy( born Giovanni Loi; 23 October 1925 – 21 August 1995) was an Italian film, theatre and TV director.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: Specifically, Nanni Loy was Sardinian, and one of several notable Sardinian film makers, including Franco Solinas.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: Loy was born in Cagliari, Sardinia: his father was Guglielmo Loy- Donà, a lawyer issue from a distinguished Sardinian- Venetian family, and his mother was the noblewoman Donna Anna Sanjust of the Marquesses of Neoneli.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: Rosetta Loy, an Italian novelist, is his sister- in- law.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: He became famous for introducing in Italy the candid camera with his show" Specchio segreto"( Secret mirror) in 1965.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: His 1962 film" The Four Days of Naples" was nominated for two Academy Awards.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: It also won the FIPRESCI Prize at the 3rd Moscow International Film Festival in 1963.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: His 1971 film" Detenuto in attesa di giudizio" was entered into the 22nd Berlin International Film Festival.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: The star, Alberto Sordi, won the Silver Bear for Best Actor award.

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: He specialized in comedy films such as" Padre di famiglia" but he also shot film dealing with social themes(" Detenuto in attesa di giudizio" and" Sistemo l' America e torno").

evidence.title: Nanni Loy
evidence.text: Loy died at Fregene, near Rome, in 1995.
